title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
html:
Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

Quest Type

Main

Event

By Moon's Grace
Chapter
Tale of Moontree Lodge

Description

The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

Steps[]

  1. Head to the "Wishing Stall" and continue the preparations
    1. Build "Pupper Theater"
    2. Build "Hsin's Fortuity"
    3. Build "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim"
  2. Wait for the Moonlit Fair to begin (set the time to after 8:00 of the next day)
  3. Head to Panhua's Restaurant
  4. Go to the place where you agreed to meet Xiangli Yao
  5. Tap Patty to enter the unknown Sonoro Sphere
    1. Investigate the anomalies in the room
    2. Find clues in the room
    3. Follow the childhood Xiangli Yao and leave
    4. Inspect the Wish Tags on the table
    5. Approach the unknown illusions
    6. Follow the Xiangli Yao and leave
    7. Investigate the anomalies in the room
    8. Inspect the researcher's log
    9. Investigate the anomalies in the room
    10. Inspect the researcher's log
    11. Investigate the anomalies in the room
    12. Inspect the researcher's log
    13. Find a way out of here
    14. Defeat the TDs
    15. Defeat "Twisted Obsessions"
    16. Bear witness to Pascar's final words
    17. Back to reality
  6. Moonlit Fair Begins
    1. Pop by "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim"
    2. Pop by "Moon Shooter"
    3. Pop by "Yumyum Haven"
    4. Talk to Zhezhi
    5. Meet up with Xiangli Yao as promised after exploring Taoyuan Vale

Gameplay Notes[]

  • This quest is limited.
  • When completing the "Wait for the Moonlit Fair to begin" step, the quest name changes from Festival Preparations IV to Before the Moonlit Fair starts, the name changes back when completing the "Head to Panhua's Restaurant" step.
  • When completing the "Tap Patty to enter the unknown Sonoro Sphere" step, the quest will be renamed to Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.
  • When completing the "Back to reality" step, the quest will be renamed to Eve of Celebration.
  • Completing the quest awards the player the Rover's Journey trophy The Moon Knows My Heart.

Dialogue[]

Panhua Restaurant is celebrating the Moonlit Fair with some new dishes. You decide to drop by and have a taste.
Abby: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), I'm hungry...
Abby: Panhua's got a must-try dish for the Moon-Chasing Fest—heard about it? Can we go try it? Puh-leeze?
Rover: Sure. Let's go try it out.
(Head to the designated location)
Rover: Hello? What's up, Chixia?
Chixia: Hey, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! You've been to the Wishing Tree, right? What did you wish for?
Chixia: Did it come tru— Oh wait, it can't be that fast...
Yangyang's Voice: Just leave it here, Chixia.
Chixia: Gotcha!
Rover: Still busy with the preparations?
Chixia: Almost finished! It's crazy here with all these people bustling around!
Chixia: You hear the buzz from our side?
Baizhi's Voice: Need to double-check the procedure. Hmm? Did I just see Madam Magistrate... Was it just me?
Zhezhi's Voice: Sorry! I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to bump into you! Ugh, I should've just stayed home to avoid causing trouble.
Chixia: Pretty hectic, isn't it?
Rover: Indeed.
Chixia: Everyone's really giving their all for this year's Moon-Chasing Festival!
Chixia: Oh, and the Loong Dance performance is happening tonight! Come and watch it with us, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! I've secured the best seat!
Sure, I'll join you.
Chixia: Hooray! That's settled then!
Can I say no?
Chixia: Seriously? What a pity... Okay then, I'll tell Yangyang and Baizhi you can't make it to the show...
Wait, I'm joking!
Chixia: You are? Whew... I thought someone else had beat me to it.
Chixia: We'll be waiting for you then!
Chixia: Before we hang up, anything you wanna say to (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), Yangyang?
Yangyang: Me? But I'm not ready...
Yangyang: Okay, erm... How're you doing today, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)?
Yangyang: I'm looking forward to enjoying the Moonlit Fair with you tonight.
Chixia: And you, Baizhi?
Baizhi: ...
Baizhi: Please come early if possible.
Baizhi: People have been preparing for the Moonlit Fair for many weeks.
Chixia: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), I just sent the coordinates to your Terminal! See you there!
Thanks. Can't wait for tonight.
Chixia: Haha, get ready to be blown away!
Abby: Hmm... Are we not going to that restaurant, then?
Rover: Let's eat there with Yangyang and the others later.
Abby: Yay! ...Wait!
Abby: I smell something delicious! It's the real deal for my empty tummy, I just know it!
Rover: Isn't that...
Xiangli Yao: Hello, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Can you come to the Moontree Lodge?
Rover: Hey, you done deciphering that fourth wish?
Xiangli Yao: Yes... As I suspected, Patty's malfunction was caused by something else.
Rover: Understood. I'll be right there.
Xiangli Yao: Thank you. I'll see you in the usual spot.
Abby: More trouble to solve eh? Wait... didn't you just promise Yangyang we'd hang out tonight?
Rover: Yeah, I did. Let's go handle it quickly so we can still make it on time.
Begin the third-stage festival preparation at Taoyuan Vale
(Head to the designated location)
Patty: Tacet Field... Hate... Pascar... The world...
Xiangli Yao: Thank you for coming, Rover.
Abby: Is that... the smell of Sonoro?!
Xiangli Yao: Patty is now a portal to a Sonoro Sphere.
Xiangli Yao: Its built-up frequencies likely resonated with something and created this.
Rover: Should we alert the Midnight Rangers? But then...
Xiangli Yao: ...Then people might think there's another TD outbreak... Since a major fight has just happened... I think we should...
Rover: We'll handle it ourselves.
Xiangli Yao: ...
Rover: You're already planning to do so, I can tell. It's written all over your face.
Xiangli Yao: Yes... I've thought it through. I believe that would be the most practical solution.
Xiangli Yao: If the Sonoro is benign, we can all breathe a sigh of relief.
Xiangli Yao: And worst-case scenario, if it turns malignant, you'll have no trouble handling it.
Xiangli Yao: I just didn't expect you to bring it up first. Guess I wasted time hesitating.
Rover: You hesitated... because of the name "Pascar"?
Xiangli Yao: Yes. He was a close friend of mine...
Xiangli Yao: He died from the Waveworn. I think... if this Sonoro Sphere is related to him, it must contain his messages for me.
Xiangli Yao: This is my personal request, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Please help me.
Rover: Sure thing. In fact, I'm also doing this for a personal reason.
Xiangli Yao: You are?
Rover: I promised my friends we'd enjoy the Moonlit Fair together tonight. Can't let this incident ruin the festivity.
Xiangli Yao: Thank you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Let's enter the Sonoro now.
(Interact with Patty)
Special objects detected...
Recalibrating data...
Retrieving visual environment...
Unknown object detected...
Xiangli Yao: It's simulating Patty's program... Well, like they say, you wouldn't know what's inside a Sonoro SphereField of Sound until you're actually inside it.
Rover: What's happening?
Abby: The Sonoro is pushing us out?!
Xiangli Yao: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), here! My hand!
???: Tacet Field... Hate... Pascar... The world...
???: Hate... Xiangli Yao...
Abby: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)!
Abby: Whew... Thank goodness you're awake.
Abby: I'm glad the Sonoro didn't throw us out.
Abby: But why us? What did we even do?
Rover: Maybe... it has something to do with that Pascar person?
Rover: Anyway, we should find Xiangli Yao first.
The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.
(Read the magazine)
Shabby Journal
When "the Genius" Meets "the Ordinary": An Exclusive Interview with the Mysterious Polymath

Q: This is your first time speaking to the public, right? Are you nervous? Everyone's been so curious about what the legendary "genius" is like.
A: Haha, actually, I've interacted with many of you on various topics without you even realizing it. Maybe you would recall discussing proton lifetime with someone named Cream Cat.

Q: That science writer Cream Cat? So it's also you! What a surprise! By the way, does this pseudonym have any special meaning?
A: It's from a little "aha" moment. Let me ask you this: ever accidentally dropped a cream cake? If you have, you've probably noticed the creamy side always hits the ground first, just like a cat always lands on its paws. Now, imagine this: stick the non-creamed side onto a cat's back, and voilà! You've got yourself a cream-cat perpetual motion machine, spinning 24/7—a true scientific marvel.

Q: It must take a whimsical and creative mind to come up with such an interesting idea. I wonder if your research on Automata Mechanics is just as imaginative.
A: To answer that, let's raise our heads and look at the starry sky through the window above. What do you see at first glance? And if you look further, what do you see next?

Q: First, the moon and stars. Beyond that, maybe planets crashing into each other or the starry sky mirroring the world we live in.
A: Now, are these just your imagination or scientific facts waiting to be confirmed? You can't find the answer if you don't imagine it first, right? It's the same with my research: imagination is part of scientification. Researchers today often focus too much on the utilitarian side of science, abandoning imagination to ensure their work contributes to mankind and the world as a whole, even if it goes against their intuition. Applied research is undoubtedly necessary for post-Lament reconstruction, but that's no reason to give up imagination, the breeding ground of science. So, my advice is... just think about how to make the science work. As for what it might yield, well... (smiles)

Q: How enlightening! Speaking of advice, do you have any for your gifted son, Xiangli Yao? As a genius yourself, you must have high expectations for him.
A: That might be a lot for a young boy to handle, but... I just hope he inherits my way of seeing things. So that one day, when he steps out of his room and tries to make sense of this world, he can look up at the sky and find the answers there.
(Read the diary)
Diary I
Today is the day of the Moon-Chasing Festival, and the teacher at school said that all wishes made on this day will come true.
In that case... I wish that Dad could come home more often.
No, wait, in the magazine, Dad said that █████████
In that case... I want to be just as amazing as him. No, I want to be an even greater scientist than him. I want to find out what the world of truth is really like with him.
Leader Kid: Oops, sorry! We didn't mean to hit your door! We're just playing cornhole here.
Frail Kid: Please don't blame our boss. It's my bad, I threw it!
Polite Kid: No, no... It's my fault... I wanted to play cornhole...
???: I-It's okay...
Leader Kid: R-really? You aren't angry at us? Thank you, you're so nice...
Pascar: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. My name's Pascar. They're Modi and Ryan.
Pascar: What's your name?
???: I'm Xiangli Yao.
Polite Kid: Xiangli Yao? Geez... You're Mrs. Xiangli Yan's son!
Pascar: Wow! So you're that genius everyone's been talking about?!
Xiangli Yao: Em...
Pascar: Wow! I heard you've never been second to anyone in school!
Xiangli Yao: Mm-hmm...
Pascar: No way! I heard you finished an entire school year's classes in one week!
Xiangli Yao: Mm-hmm...
Pascar: That's amazing! And you've solved a century-old problem for the Academy too?!
Xiangli Yao: Huh? Is that what they've been saying about me?
Pascar: YOU'RE SO COOL!
Modi: Chill, boss. You might scare him.
Ryan: You're just like my big sis when she meets her idol.
Pascar: Shush!
Pascar: Ahem... Sorry, I got ahead of myself.
Pascar: By the way, we're going to the Moonlit Fair. Care to join us?
Xiangli Yao: Are you sure...?
Pascar: 'Course you can! We can make you the new boss even!
Xiangli Yao: The... boss?
Pascar: Yeah, like, our leader... But that's not important. The real question is, do you wanna play with us?
Xiangli Yao: I...
Xiangli Yao: Sorry... I think I'll stay at home. I must wait for my dad...
Ryan: Your dad? The big inventor mentioned in the headlines? Said he's gone missing...
Pascar: Hey, shut up!
Xiangli Yao: ...
Pascar: W-we gotta go now. Come find us anytime you wanna play!
Pascar: I don't like being alone. Don't know if you feel the same.
Pascar: Anyway, we're here when you need a chat or someone to hang out with.
Xiangli Yao: Okay...
Abby: That looks like something from Xiangli Yao's childhood. Could his memories be affecting this Sonoro's frequencies?
Rover: Maybe it's not just his memories.
Xiangli Yao: Wait!
Abby: We can go through that door now. Let's move.
(Follow the childhood Xiangli Yao and leave)
Abby: What is this place?
Rover: A Wishing Stall? But the decorations don't match this year's theme.
Abby: Do we need to touch anything or read anything here, like we did in the last room?
Rover: There are some wish tags on the floor. Let's read them.
(Go through the Wish Tags)
View the neat Wish Tag
Wish Tag
Failed experiments, unmet goals... I've had enough! I just want to be heard...
View the crumpled Wish Tag
Wish Tag
I promised my boy I'd witness the Ovathrax's defeat and the peace he had fought so hard for.
View the folded Wish Tag
Wish Tag
I wanna be a great hero like Flame Ranger from the hero plays. He's strong, he's brave and tough in the face of despair, and he has a squad of awesome friends. We need everyone safe and sound together to truly protect what we care about.
Rover: Hoping to be heard, missing a departed son, wanting to become a hero... These are the wishes of the people I've helped.
Rover: There are two more wish tags.
View the creased Wish Tag
Wish Tag
If people want food, they pay. If they want pay, they work. But what should I do, if what I want is EVERYTHING about this world?
View the smooth Wish Tag
Wish Tag
Father, what is your wish? To help people make their wishes come true?
Abby: It worked! Your intuition can be really sharp.
(Head to the designated location)
Pascar: Can't believe I actually got a zero. What a bummer... I'm not even in the mood for wishes now...
Xiangli Yao: Still upset about what happened in class?
Pascar: I mean, aren't we supposed to learn by doing? That's what we've been taught since day one.
Pascar: We know next to nothing about the the Waveworn Phenomena and our equipment is useless. Shouldn't we go explore it firsthand?
Xiangli Yao: But how? Shall we set up a lab by a Waveworn site, like you said in class? It's too risky. If something goes wrong, the staff won't make it.
Pascar: But this is the martyrdom of science, the necessary sacrifice! Like chemists who sampled unknown substances, we must risk it all for the ultimate truth.
Xiangli Yao: Really? Do we have to risk it all?
Pascar: Of course! You want food, you pay. You want pay, you work. Give something to get something.
Pascar: When the truth of this world—the ultimate knowledge—is on the line, one must be willing to give up everything they have.
Xiangli Yao: ...We'll discuss it later. Modi and Ryan want to catch up. How about meeting them today?
Pascar: I have no time.
Xiangli Yao: You've been avoiding them since they failed the entrance exam.
Pascar: It's necessary. As intellectuals, we must walk a solitary path.
Pascar: Those who can't keep up will only hold us back. It's best to leave them behind sooner rather than later.
Pascar: Why would a genius like you care about their feelings anyway? With your father as a role model, distractions should be beneath you.
Pascar: Come on. What if they drag you down?
Xiangli Yao: But... I don't think we have to be lonely as intellectuals.
Pascar: ...Remember that old Moontree Lodge tale from a decade ago? Write a wish, hang it on the Wishing Tree, and presto—your wish comes true.
Pascar: But let's be real, there's gotta be a person running that show. Because when the word got out, it just stopped working.
Pascar: More wishes were made, but how many actually came true? Not many.
Pascar: See? Not even that "Unsung Hero of the Lodge" had time to grant every wish.
Pascar: Our time in this world is limited, so let's focus on the truth, not trivialities.
Xiangli Yao: ...
Pascar: Trying to organize your arguments to refute me? ...Go ahead if you must, Mr. Genius.
Pascar: You know, I only said that because I value you as my only friend and opponent.
Pascar: I just don't want you to get distracted. It's not satisfying to outdo someone when they're not at their best.
Pascar: Well, that's enough talk for today. I'll make my wish now.
Pascar: Let's see... Well, Wishing Tree, please make the Waveworn happen. Then I can finally study it up close.
Xiangli Yao: Pascar!
Pascar: Haha, chill, dude. Just kidding.
Xiangli Yao: As an intellectual, I must prioritize my pursuit of truth, even if it means a life of solitude...
Xiangli Yao: Then, father... Why did I find driveshafts of your design in the Moontree Lodge...
Xiangli Yao: You were never home during Moon-Chasing Festivals... Were you busy helping other people?
Xiangli Yao: If that's what you did... Does it mean I don't really have to be alone...
Xiangli Yao: What should I do...
Pascar's Voice: Hey, Xiangli! What are you doing there? C'mon, we gotta go now.
Xiangli Yao: Okay.
Abby: The festival must mean something different to him. Is that why he's running the Moontree Lodge after his father's passing?
Abby: Is that a form of human connection too?
Rover: Sort of.
Abby: Are we sharing that kind of connection right now?
Rover: I'd say you've been haunting me. Like a ghost.
Abby: Haunting? Hmph! No way. Admit it, I'm just living rent-free in your head.
Rover: Sure, if you say so... Now back to the topic. We've been seeing Pascar and Xiangli Yao's past exclusively so far.
Abby: So? Isn't that pretty normal in a Sonoro like this?
Rover: But why can't we get through the "doors" before Xiangli Yao opens them?
Abby: Hmm... Strange indeed. It's almost as if he owns this place!
Rover: Or maybe... he holds the key? Is it similar to what Scar did to me... No, I can't tell for sure yet.
Rover: Let's press on. We need to go deeper to uncover the truth.
(Head to the designated location)
Abby: Hmm? This room isn't empty.
(Head to the designated location)
Meticulous Researcher: Our research has been great. Hopefully we'll keep this momentum going into the next year.
Optimistic Researcher: With the progress we've made so far, we'll surely figure out the Tacet Fields one day.
Easygoing Researcher: Well, we have Pascar and Xiangli Yao to thank.
Nervous Researcher: Yeah. Where did Xiangli go? He's never here with us during the Moon-Chasing Festival.
(Inspect the researcher's log)
This is the initial trial of the 11371A Automated Observation Machine.
It successfully recorded all data observed in Tacet Field HL-057. Upon extrapolation and comparison with theoretical data models, the fitting accuracy remained between 0.8 and 0.85, demonstrating high precision.
The initial trial of the 11371A Automated Observation Machine conducted by ███ and ███ was successful.
Data Recording Summary:
Wavelength ranging between ███ and ███ nanometers...
A Researcher's Diary
Day 21... Oh no, it's 22 now. Got too thrilled to remember the correct date. The experiment yesterday was indeed invigorating.
"When people are hungry, they work to earn credits to buy food. But when my mind hungers for knowledge about this world, what can I offer to satisfy that craving?"
The words of that researcher have been echoing in my mind ever since then...
By observing the Tacet Fields, we will definitely be able to find the cause of this disaster and redefine the science of our times.
Abby: Did we just end up back in the same place?
Abby: Something feels off here...
(Head to the designated location)
"Meticulous" Researcher: Another failed experiment! When will we invest in better equipment for accurate results?!
"Optimistic" Researcher: This is pointless! The Waveworn has destroyed all our theories. There's no pattern at all!
"Easygoing" Researcher: Our research has been a waste of time! It's all your fault!
"Nervous" Researcher: We need Xiangli Yao... Pascar, where is Xiangli Yao? Where the hell is he!
(Inspect the researcher's log)
This is the ███th observation on Tacet Field HL-057, conducted by 11371A Automated Observation Machine.
The constant value for measurement ███ has been adjusted to 3.7426, showing a significant deviation from the previous constant value of 7.6587.
System analysis indicates the following reasons:
<<< Theories III-001, III-002, III-003... have completely failed.
<<< Theories II-037 and II-056 show conditional limitations.
<<< Theories IV-396, IV-452...
<<< Waveworn Phenomenon seriously affected the accuracy of data observed...
A Researcher's Diary
Same research conditions and same observation procedures, but how could the result change this time? It was ███ in the last experiment.
No, it can't be. There must be a malfunction with the automated observation machine, or perhaps we made a mistake in one of the procedures.
Gotta try again, just one more time...
We've put so much effort into building this system! It can't be wrong!
Abby: This is the third time we've circled back here!
Abby: Let's look around and get out of here quick.
(Head to the designated location)
██████ Researcher: I can't do this anymore... It's over... I'm useless...
██████ Researcher: Nonsense... It's all nonsense... Countless errors... No solution!
██████ Researcher: It's not me... It's them! No, it's the world! The whole world is wrong! Hahahaha!
██████ Researcher: Where is Xiangli Yao?! You're nobody compared to him, Pascar!
(Inspect the researcher's log)
This is the ███th observation on Tacet Field HL-057, conducted by 11371A Automated Observation Machine.
Recorded content: None.
Because everything is utterly devoid of meaning.
A Researcher's Diary
More researchers have left... No one's going to continue the research on the Tacet Field.
It feels like everything we've been studying is akin to planting a seed in a Petri dish out in the Tacet Field. And guess what? That seed might germinate, dissolve into the culture solution, or even mutate into a monster and burst out.
Our research is just as chaotic. Experimental data that should remain constant at 3.74 can suddenly skyrocket to 7.65 the next moment. Is this the truth we've been pursuing? How bitterly ironic!
I would feel somewhat relieved if such an impossible error was due to my own incompetence. But if the Lament has already overturned the very order of this world, what's the point of scientific inquiry?
<<< Reading data, Researcher: ███ and ███ have withdrawn from the research
<<< System message, Researchers: ███, ███ and ███ ...
<<< I still can't accept it. If the incorrect theory was because of my own lack of ability, that would almost be a relief. But now...
<<< System message, Researcher: Pascar
<<< No... Your wishes, my wishes... I will carry them to the destination we've all been longing for.
<<< Keywords found: Wishes, visual environment recalibrating...
Abby: Finally, we're out... but this new place looks even creepier.
(Touch the illusion)
Shifan's Illusion?: So tired... I wanna disappear... Screw everything!
Abby: Hey, ain't that the Shifan guy?
Abby: He smells delicious... Ahem! I mean, he looks even worse than yesterday, when he wrote down his wish...
Rover: The others are probably no better than him...
(Touch the illusion)
Heying's Illusion?: My son... I miss you so much... Take me away with you...
Rover: She's been affected too...
Abby: Even that granny has gone crazy...
(Touch the illusion)
Mahn's Illusion?: Ahaha... I'm the best!
Mahn's Illusion?: Watch me take on anything! Let the world burn, I'll still come out on top!
Abby: ...Well, this one doesn't sound too depressing...
Abby: But if it ever comes true, I have a feeling it's gonna be hella dangerous!
Rover: Hmm... I think I know who the remaining two will be.
(Touch the illusion)
Pascar's Illusion?: Science doesn't exist...
Pascar's Illusion?: We knew it! We knew it right from the start! The Waveworn Phenomenon defies all laws of physics!
Pascar's Illusion?: And the worst part? It's completely random! We need more data!
Pascar's Illusion?: How are we supposed to study the Tacet Field in this chaos?
Pascar's Illusion?: I knew it... We never have enough samples! Now, if we could make Waveworn disasters happen more often...
Pascar's Illusion?: Don't you try to stop me, cowards! You don't even have the guts to sacrifice for the truth!
Pascar's Illusion?: You all despise me, thinking I'll never surpass Xiangli Yao, right?
Pascar's Illusion?: Ha! If this were his idea, not a single one of you would object!
Pascar's Illusion?: Fine! I'll do it myself!
Pascar's Illusion?: Hahaha... I did it! Now I'm just a heartbeat away from success!
Pascar's Illusion?: Stay back! Stay away from here!
Xiangli Yao's Illusion?: His wish... achieved... He is not guilty...
Xiangli Yao's Illusion?: Must... trigger... the Waveworn... Tacet Field...
Abby: He can't be serious!
Abby: So he's gonna trigger the Waveworn disaster like Pascar planned to?!
Rover: We shouldn't jump to conclusions yet. Not based on a few broken words.
Rover: He's willing to go to great lengths for other people. He wouldn't want to do that.
Xiangli Yao's Illusion?: My friend's quest for truth was genuine till his last breath!
Xiangli Yao's Illusion?: I will not let you... tarnish his goal like that!
Abby: It's Xiangli Yao! He's right behind this door!
Abby: But it won't budge...
Rover: Then I'll smash it open!
Abby: By brute force?!
<<< Detected spikes across multiple environmental parameters...
<<< [System Message] From Research Fellow, Pascar:
<<< ...vision... See! We've finally made a dent in Tacet Field studies. All was not... for nothing.
<<< Is that... the Waveworn phenomenon? Xiangli Yao, I...
<<< Confirming final message: Xiangli Yao
<<< Coordinates and object info redefined, visualizing...
Xiangli Yao: The innermost area of this Sonoro Sphere... Pascar, are you there?
Xiangli Yao: Sorry, Rover... I must go and face him myself.
Xiangli Yao: Stop hiding, Pascar. We can talk it out.
(Defeat the TDs)
Twisted Obsessions: Hate... The world... Rest... Turn back time... Destruction...
